approved: Treasury Laws Amendment (2017 Measures No. 3) Bill 2017

The Labor Party supports the Treasury Laws Amendment (2017 Measures No. 3) Bill 2017, which validates certain ASIC staff employment agreements and delegated powers made before 9 March 2017 to remedy legal uncertainty from a defect under the ASIC Act.

The Treasury Laws Amendment (2017 Measures No. 3) Bill 2017 retrospectively validates invalid delegations of power to a small number of ASIC employees caused by a 1999 administrative error, removing legal risks without affecting current or former staff.
Treasury Laws Amendment (2017 Measures No. 3) Act 2017
